verdict.rationale: Browserbase explicitly markets tracking 'prices, job listings, product changes, and competitor moves as they happen' and running agents that 'alert you the moment something breaks,' backed by scheduled/on-demand agent runs (docs-14) and webhook event notifications instead of polling (docs-19–21). However, this requires the data-engineer to build the monitoring/diffing logic themselves via agents rather than a turnkey change-detection feature. Missing for 10: a dedicated built-in diff/change-detection mechanism and independent evidence of this monitoring use case working reliably at scale.
